limits: One covered and one undrained control; old completed submission counts and scene times differ, so this is not a matched-workload benchmark.
Latest fence completion concerns prior commands on the old GL stream; it does not prove physical GPU-memory reclamation, compositor presentation, or completion of later disposal commands.
Only compileShader/linkProgram/getShaderParameter/getProgramParameter native calls were timed. Other GL calls, JavaScript, observer overhead and browser/driver internals remain untraced.
Long synchronous renderer.render and heartbeat lag do not establish the internal GPU/driver cause.
The covered wait moves an observed old-context completion wait before disposal; it is not a production performance improvement or an unchanged original-gate pass.
PNG byte identity covers the three recorded fixed-pose images, not every animated/input state.
